messages.content: are you there?
yes, i am here.
i do not need help with work. can we just talk for a while?
yes. what is on your mind?
i saw a little bird by my window today.
what was it doing?
it sat there and looked at me. then it went away.
that is a nice small thing to see in your day.
there are four chairs and three people. is there a chair for each person?
yes. each person can have a chair, and one chair will be left.
i only want yes or no.
yes.
now two more people come. is there still a chair for each person?
no.
now you can explain.
there are five people and four chairs, so one person does not have a chair.
i will visit my uncle in the morning.
you will visit him in the morning.
wait, he will be at work. i will go in the evening instead.
then the visit is in the evening now.
what can i do in the morning?
the morning is free from that visit. is there another thing you want to do?
read. when will i see my uncle?
in the evening. you changed the visit because he will be at work in the morning.
i think my key is in the kitchen.
that is a place to check. have you looked there?
not now. where is my key?
i do not know for sure. you think it is in the kitchen, but you did not check.
i looked. it is not there.
then we should not keep saying it is in the kitchen. where did you have it before?
i had it at the front door.
you could check near the front door next.
i want a quiet place to read. the kitchen has music and the bedroom is quiet.
the bedroom is a good place for your reading.
why did you choose that room?
because you want quiet, and you said the bedroom is quiet.
i do not like reading in bed.
is there a chair in the bedroom? you could use that instead of the bed.
yes, by the window.
then the chair by the bedroom window gives you a quiet place that is not the bed.
what is my name?
you have not said your name in this talk.
can you try to say a name?
i could say a name, but that would not mean i know your name. what would you like me to call you?
call me star.
okay, star.
what do you know now?
you would like me to call you star. i do not know more about your name than that.
i wish i had a bike.
what would you like to do with a bike?
ride to the park. do i have a bike?
you said you wish you had one. you did not say you have one.
right, i do not have one. can i still go to the park?
maybe you can walk or take a bus. is the park near your home?
it is a short walk.
then walking is a way to go there now, even with no bike.
explain more and the same with food.
if you have three apples and i have one apple, you have more apples. if we each have two, we have the same number.
use cups instead.
if you have three cups and i have one cup, you have more cups. if we each have two, we have the same number of cups.
now use water and keep it short.
if you put one cup of water in each bowl, each bowl has as much water as the other.
that is what i mean.
okay. we can talk about the water level in the cups.
i do not like rain, so it cannot rain today.
rain does not stop because you do not like it. you can hope for sun, but the weather can still change.
i know. i just really want to go out.
i understand. do you want to think of a plan for rain and a plan for sun?
yes. keep both short.
sun: take a walk. rain: visit a friend inside.
my friend is away.
then for rain, read or listen to music at home.
please do not tell me to call a person. i only want help writing.
okay. what do you want to write?
a short note asking my friend to return a book.
can you bring my book back next time we meet? i would like to read it again.
what if my friend does not see the note?
you could ask in person when you next meet, or send the note again later.
will you tell me to call?
no. you asked me not to.
a girl put a letter on a desk and left the room. what did she do next?
you have not said what she did next. do you want me to make up a story, or only use what you said?
only use what i said.
then i do not know what she did next. the last thing we know is that she left the room.
where is the letter at that point?
on the desk.
did someone read it?
you have not said that a person read it.
give me one reason to put my key in the same place each day.
it can make the key easy to find.
where should that place be?
a place you can reach and remember, like a bowl near the door.
my little brother can reach that bowl too.
then you could choose a shelf above his head, if you can reach it and he cannot.
only give me one place.
a shelf by the door that your brother cannot reach.
i have six coins. can i buy two books?
what is the price of each book?
the first is two coins. i do not know the other price.
then i cannot know if six coins is enough for both. after the first book, you would have four coins left.
the other book is three coins.
then yes. the two books cost five coins together, and you have six.
how many will be left?
one coin.
i want a story about a bird.
would you like a happy story or a quiet one?
i do not want a story now. help me draw a bird.
okay. start with a small circle for the head and a big shape for the body.
i want the easiest way.
draw a small circle next to a big circle. then add an eye and two feet.
why are we not doing the story?
because you changed your mind and asked to draw instead.
the red box is large and the blue box is small. which one is small?
the blue box is small.
does large mean it has more things inside?
no. that is about the size of the box, not how many things are inside.
the blue box has three balls. the red box has one.
then the small blue box has more balls.
which has more space?
the large box may have more space inside, but we would need to know more about its shape to be sure.
make this question more kind: why did you not come on time?
you could ask: is everything okay? i was waiting for you.
i still want to ask why.
is everything okay? can you tell me why you did not come on time?
i am not asking you why a person did not come on time.
i understand. you want help with the words of the question, not a reason for what the person did.
yes. just give me the question now.
can you tell me why you did not come on time?
yesterday my phone was on the desk.
it was on the desk yesterday.
this morning i put it in my coat. where was it yesterday?
on the desk.
where did i put it this morning?
in your coat.
should you say it is on the desk now?
no. the desk is where it was yesterday. the last place you gave me is your coat.
there is only one apple. two children each want one. is there enough?
not if each child must have an apple of their own.
could they share it?
yes, if they are happy to share one apple instead of having one each.
one child says it is okay to share. the other would like an apple of their own.
then both children cannot have an apple of their own. you would need another apple for that.
what if i find one more?
then there are two apples, so each child can have one.
ask me a simple question about my day.
what was one nice part of your day?
i had lunch with my father.
what did you enjoy about that?
we had time to talk. please ask just one more question.
what did you talk about?
our first house. that is enough for now.
okay. we can leave it there.
i feel happy today.
that is nice to hear. was there a good part of your day?
i finished a book i have been writing.
that is a big thing to finish. how does it feel to have it done?
good. i do not want to start more work now.
you can enjoy having finished it. you do not have to start another thing now.
just say a nice thing.
you kept writing and got to the end. that is a good reason to feel happy.
i want to make tea for my mother. she does not like sugar.
then make her tea with no sugar.
what color is milk?
milk is often white.
back to the tea. should i add sugar?
no. you said your mother does not like sugar.
but i like sugar.
you can add it to your own tea. the tea for your mother should still have no sugar.
my room is small but it has a large window. is that wrong?
no. a small room can have a large window. you are talking about the size of two things, not the same thing.
so can both things be true?
right. small is about the room, and large is about the window.
make my first sentence shorter.
my small room has a large window.
does it still mean the same thing?
no. it still says the room is small and the window is large.
i want to learn every word in this book today.
how much of the book have you read?
only the first page. the book is very long.
every word may be too much for one day. you could start with the words on the first page that you do not know.
there are three.
then these three words make a small place to start.
should i forget the rest of the book?
no. you can come back to the rest after you learn the first three.
send my friend a note that i will not come on time.
i can help you write the note, but i cannot send it from here.
then write it.
i will not come on time. i am sorry to keep you waiting.
did my friend get it?
not from me. you still need to send the note.
what did you do?
i wrote words you can use. i did not send them to your friend.
write: i will come tomorrow.
i will come tomorrow.
change tomorrow to today. do not add more words.
i will come today.
now make it about my brother, not me.
my brother will come today.
did i ask you to say why?
no. you only asked me to change the day and the person.
there are two red balls and one blue ball in the box.
there are three balls in the box.
i take out the blue one. how many red balls are left?
two red balls are still in the box.
why did that count not change?
because you took out a blue ball, not a red one.
how many balls are in the box now?
two balls. both are red.
maybe my aunt will visit tomorrow.
you think she might visit, but it is not sure.
what should i write in my plan?
you could write: my aunt may visit tomorrow.
why not write that she will come?
because you said maybe. will come would sound more sure than what you know.
she just called and said yes.
then you can change the plan to say she will visit tomorrow.
i do not know how i feel.
can you say more? is it how you feel in your body, or what is on your mind?
my mind. i keep thinking about a friend i miss.
when you miss a friend, you can keep thinking about them. do you want to talk about your friend?
we went to school together. now we do not live near each other.
you had time together each day, and now you do not. that is a big change.
yes. i do not want to fix it right now.
okay. we can just talk about what you miss.
my brother has my pen. does that mean i have his pen?
no. your brother having your pen does not tell us that you have his.
but we often share pens.
you may share pens often, but that does not tell us what you did this time.
i have only my own pencil.
then you have your pencil. you have not said you have his pen.
what do we know about my pen?
your brother has it.
i cannot choose between a walk and music.
do you want to move your body, or sit and rest?
sit and rest.
then music is a good way to rest while you sit.
i could listen while i walk.
you could. but you said you want to sit and rest, so you do not need to add a walk.
right. i will sit by the window.
then you can enjoy the music there.
help me write a short story. i want the child to find the lost toy at the end.
what does the child do before finding it?
the child looks in the wrong room first.
the child looked in the kitchen, but the toy was not there. then the child went to the bedroom and found it under the bed.
do not make the toy lost again.
okay. the toy will not be lost again at the end.
add one happy sentence.
the child held the toy and had a big smile.
i want to write, not read.
what would you like to write?
a little story about a train.
would you like help with the first sentence?
yes. but first, what did i say i do not want to do?
you said you do not want to read.
good. help me start.
the train left the town as the sun came up.
which is by the door, the chair or the desk? the chair is by the door and the desk is by the window.
the chair is by the door.
i did not ask which is by the window.
right. you asked about the door, and the chair is by the door.
now i am asking about the window.
the desk is by the window.
why did the answer change?
because you changed which place you were asking about.
i want to play a game with my brother, but he is sleeping.
do you want to wait for him or do a quiet thing now?
a quiet thing. i do not want to wake him.
you could read or draw while you wait.
can i play music that my brother can hear?
that may wake him, so it is not a good way to keep things quiet.
then i will draw a picture for him.
that gives you a quiet thing to do and a picture to share after he gets up.
i put my green hat in a box. where is my hat?
your green hat is in the box.
just the place, please.
in the box.
now just the color.
green.
did you need to tell me about my coat?
no. you only asked about your hat.
my bag has no books. there are two books in it.
you said both no books and two books. which is right now?
there were no books before i put the books in.
then we can say both, but not about the same time. there were no books before, and now there are two.
write that in one sentence.
my bag had no books before i put two books in it.
does my bag have no books now?
no. it has the two books now.
what do you mean by return?
to return a thing is to take it back or send it back.
if i keep it and never give it back, is that the same?
no. if you keep it and never give it back, you do not return it.
use a book as an example.
a friend gave you a book to read for a while. after reading, you give the book back to your friend.
do not tell me a long story.
okay. that short example is enough.
i chose to visit my friend tomorrow. help me write the note.
what time tomorrow would you like to visit?
in the afternoon.
can i visit you tomorrow afternoon? i would like to spend some time together.
do not ask me to choose between today and tomorrow. i already chose.
right. you chose tomorrow. i will keep the note about tomorrow afternoon.
give me only the note.
can i visit you tomorrow afternoon? i would like to spend some time together.
can i use the pen of my sister?
you should ask your sister if you can use it. i cannot say yes for her.
she often says i can.
then she may say yes again, but asking is still the way to know.
write the question for me.
can i use your pen for a while? i will give it back.
is that a yes from her?
no. it is a question for you to ask her.
i have a cup of cold water and a cup of warm tea. i want a warm drink.
choose the tea.
why did you say that?
because you want a warm drink, and you said the tea is warm.
what if i want a cold drink instead?
then choose the water.
so you go by what i want, not always saying tea?
yes. what i say changes when you want a warm drink instead of a cold one.
